label: TMUA 2023 · Paper 2 · Question 15
knowledgePattern: Sum repeating binary place values as an infinite geometric series
solution:
The first block 0011 contributes 2−3+2−4=3/16. Moving a block four binary places to the right multiplies its contribution by 2−4=1/16.

The value is an infinite GP with first term 3/16 and ratio 1/16, whose magnitude is below 1. Its sum is 3/161−1/16=1/5. Answer B.

Equivalently, multiplying the recurring value by 16 shifts one whole block; subtraction leaves 15z=3, so z=1/5.
